title: Proration and tier billing auditor
job: Audit prorated and tiered charges, identifying duplicate, missing and incorrectly calculated billing rows.
method: UTC-day proration, exact tier arithmetic and statement-line reconciliation.
recovery: Correct period boundaries, tiers or duplicate lines; day granularity is explicit and does not emulate a provider's second-level policy.
acceptance: Charge rounding is per declared line; a mismatched total cannot hide individual duplicate or missing charges.
novelty_scope: Algorithms and domain operations have established prior art. The evaluated contribution is the bounded executable resource and small-model integration, not invention of the underlying task.

problem_evidence.evidence: User requested inexpensive AI resources that improve completion of specific domain jobs.
The linked existing tools and their manuals document the recurring task and established solutions. No user interview or unmeasured frustration count is invented.
